# Planck 1.5.0

Offline ESM distribution of https://github.com/piqnt/planck.js (MIT; LICENSE.txt).
The game imports dist/planck.mjs. No network service or npm runtime is required.
collapse-physics.js owns the numerical settings, including increased convex
polygon capacity, contact slop and sleep tolerances. Source distribution code
is unmodified. Game fixtures use polygon ground surfaces.
